item.title: I built a library that makes MicroPython feel like a web framework – looking for feedback
item.description: Hey! I got tired of writing low-level register code for sensors, so I made a declarative abstraction layer. Instead of bit-shifting I2C data, you write: sensor = hardware.attach("I2C", type="BME280") sensor.on_threshold("temperature > 25°C", lambda e: fan.on()) It's called BitBound, available on PyPI. Supports 20+ devices, runs in simulation mode for desktop testing. Happy to share the link if anyone's interested – just comment below! What sensors/actuators would you want supported?

item.title: Stop Writing Selectors: How I Vibe Coded a Production AppSumo Scraper
